content.title: World Cup 2026 | Match schedule, fixtures & stadiums
content.text: World Cup 2026 will be the biggest and most exciting edition of the tournament to date as 48 teams from around the globe compete in 104 fixtures.On this page you'll find the full FIFA World Cup 2026™ schedule, including all match fixtures, dates and venues, plus live results from the games played across 16 host cities in Canada, Mexico and the United States. You can also view details of all World Cup 2026 groups, live standings, the bracket/knockout rounds, and get access to tickets and hospitality packages.From the tournament's first whistle on 11 June to the last kick of the FIFA World Cup 2026™ Final on 19 July, everything you need is right here.Tap to download the full World Cup match schedule with all fixtures and locationsTap to download the full World Cup match schedule with all fixtures and locationsTap for World Cup 2026 ticket informationTap for World Cup 2026 ticket informationFIFA World Cup 2026 Group Stage fixturesFIFA World Cup 2026 Group Stage fixturesThursday, 11 June 2026Thursday, 11 June 2026Mexico v South Africa -
